name: s3_switch_faint
purpose: Switching and fainting to the end: a voluntary switch moves ahead of every move and its newcomer (Farigiraf, Normal) takes the Shadow Ball aimed at the slot without effect; faints cancel the moves of the fainted, replacements come in at the end of the turn, a target that fainted is replaced by a random foe, and the battle ends with a winner.
